another_claimant_lives_with_child.description: Whether someone who lives with the child is already claiming Child Benefit for them.

care_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in local authority care.

care_home_24h_per_week.description: Whether the child spends at least 24 hours per week at home while in local authority care.

hospital_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in hospital or residential accommodation.

claimant_spends_on_child.description: Whether the claimant regularly spends money on the child (e.g. food, clothes, books) while the child is in hospital or residential accommodation.

is_fostered.description: Whether the child is fostered by the claimant.

council_pays_for_child.description: Whether the local council pays towards the child's accommodation or maintenance.

works_24_plus_hours.description: Whether the child works 24 or more hours per week in paid employment.

started_apprenticeship_in_england.description: Whether the child has started an apprenticeship in England.

receives_qualifying_benefits.description: Whether the child receives qualifying benefits in their own right, such as Universal Credit or Employment and Support Allowance.

Hello! I'd be happy to help you determine your eligibility for Child Benefit. I can see you're asking about Child Benefit for Alex, who is 8 years old and lives with you in the UK.

To properly assess your eligibility, I need to ask you a few questions:

1. **Is anyone else currently claiming Child Benefit for Alex?** (Only one person can get Child Benefit for a child)

2. **Do you have the right to reside in the UK?** For example:
   - Are you a British citizen?
   - Do you have settled or pre-settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme?
   - Do you have another immigration status that gives you the right to reside?

3. **Are you responsible for Alex?** This means you either:
   - Live with them (which you've indicated you do), OR
   - Pay at least the same amount as Child Benefit towards their upkeep (food, clothes, pocket money, etc.)

Could you please provide this information so I can make an accurate assessment of your eligibility?

## Good news! You are **ELIGIBLE** for Child Benefit for Alex.

### Summary:

You meet all the standard eligibility requirements for Child Benefit:

- ✓ You live in the UK
- ✓ Alex is 8 years old (under 16)
- ✓ Alex lives with you, so you're responsible for them
- ✓ None of the disqualifying factors apply

### Important things to remember:

1. **Only one person can claim** - Make sure no one else is currently claiming Child Benefit for Alex. If someone else is claiming, you would need to resolve this before applying.

2. **High Income Child Benefit tax charge** - If you or your partner have an individual income over £60,000, you may have to pay a tax charge. You can still claim Child Benefit but may need to repay some or all of it through your tax return.

3. **Next steps** - If you haven't already claimed, you should [apply for Child Benefit](https://www.gov.uk/child-benefit/how-to-claim) as soon as possible, as it can only be backdated for up to 3 months.

If you have any other questions about Child Benefit or need help with the application process, please feel free to ask!
